facts.business: Naksh Precious Metals Limited operates in the gems and jewellery sector, engaged in the manufacturing and export of cut and polished diamonds and gold jewellery.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Department of Commerce target for India's gem and jewellery exports
Department of Commerce long-term aspiration for India's gem and jewellery exports

auditor.name: JNG & Co. LLP
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Secretarial Audit observations: 1) Non-dissemination of required documents on website (Shareholding Pattern, Annual Return link, Corporate Governance Report). 2) Delayed UPSI entries in SDD Software and non-filing of SDD Shareholding for Q4 FY26. 3) Delayed submission of Reconciliation of Share Capital Audit Report for Q1-Q3 FY26 and non-submission for Q4 FY26. 4) Non-filing of e-form for appointment/regularisation of Mr. Vinit Picha as Independent Director and non-filing of Form DIR-12 for multiple director changes across years.

key_risks: High import dependence for raw materials (~90% of rough diamonds and gold bars)
Export market concentration risk (US shipments declined 44.92% in FY26)
Volatile gold prices affecting consumer behaviour and working capital intensity
Lab-grown diamond price correction impacting exports
Highly fragmented and unorganised industry competition
Regulatory non-compliances in secretarial filings and disclosures
facts.related_party_note: The Company did not have any material significant related party transactions having a potential conflict with the interest of the Company at large. Transactions with related parties are disclosed in the audited financial statements. Shareholders approved material related party transactions via Special Resolution at AGM held on September 30, 2025.
